name: UwULend
fix_description: The sUSDe oracle uses a median of multiple Curve pool prices (FRAXUSDe, USDeUSDC, USDeDAI, USDecrvUSD, GHOUSDe). The attacker manipulated 5 of these pools simultaneously via flash loan to skew the median. Fix: use manipulation-resistant price sources (Chainlink) instead of DEX spot prices, or add TWAP requirement and price deviation circuit breakers that reject sudden price changes within a single block.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is mechanically short, but the exploit requires understanding protocol-specific collateral/accounting behavior: using transferred uSUSDE to preserve health factor, flash-loaning WETH, borrowing out multiple reserves, then withdrawing the WETH collateral despite the debt. This is more than a trivial missing-access-control bug and depends on reading UWU Lend’s lending logic and health factor calculations.
